title: Fable 5.1 keeps filtering me for cybersecurity when all I'm doing is modding a singleplayer game.
author: Dogbold
selftext:
I'm just having it edit models, use Blender, add morph shapes, and add new behavior to the game. It's making .bat files to run and generating models and previews and stuff.

Was going great for a while, doing exactly what I asked it to.

And then all of a sudden I got this.

https://preview.redd.it/v9urzczzcyoh1.png?width=1151&format=png&auto=webp&s=a7d4971c23ff5a0800b9dcc84c9022bec32ca064

No idea why it happened. Maybe the .bat files? But it needs those to do this work, because it can't just open Blender itself apparently as it runs in a "Linux VM".

So I tried to ask it what it thinks we can do to avoid this since it's a false flag, and then it got flagged again just... reading the disk.

https://preview.redd.it/w4g7yw75dyoh1.png?width=1157&format=png&auto=webp&s=e407e8d30f6c8ad627f22af50b8ac7ea6365a7f3

And now I can't do anything with this chat at all. It won't let me edit and retry anymore, because I get this.

https://preview.redd.it/xvpe04z6dyoh1.png?width=540&format=png&auto=webp&s=ad6a2e915633f09e14bd06617918760f110d4ae8

So now this project is dead because for some absurd reason, unlike almost all other AI models, Claude cannot see any other chat. It can't read them, or see what was done in any of them at all.  
So I'd need to start all over from the beginning.

Is there any way to prevent this false flag again and having it destroy the entire project?

comments.author: cxfoulke
comments.body: What game? A game with modding support or not... Without it, it might be trying to decompile the binary which would make sense to hit cyber security flags.

replies.author: Dogbold
replies.body: Claude said the game had support for modding and tools in it to help.

replies.author: cxfoulke
replies.body: By the sound of those names it doesn't
